events.what: AlphaEvolve (Novikov et al.) evolves a search heuristic that finds a 95-piece step function giving upper bound 0.380924, beating Haugland's 2016 0.380926
events.ai_basis: AlphaEvolve established a new upper bound for the minimum overlap problem, slightly improving upon the previous record. Each generation of AlphaEvolve was tasked with evolving a program representing a search heuristic...

events.what: TTT-Discover (Yuksekgonul et al.) finds an asymmetric 600-piece step function giving 0.380876; checked by Torlo
events.ai_basis: TTT-Discover improved the upper bound on Erdős' Minimum Overlap Problem to 0.380876 ... the solution from TTT-Discover is an asymmetric construction, finding a 600-piece step function

events.what: Together AI EinsteinArena agents report 0.380871, 'purely obtained by AI agents'
SimpleTES (Ye et al.), using gpt-oss-120b/20b, reaches upper bound 0.380868, the current record
events.ai_basis: SimpleTES reaches 0.380868, ahead of the best human (0.380927), AlphaEvolve (0.380924, Gemini-2.0 Pro), and TogetherAI (0.380871).

judgement.doubts: All four events are successive bounds on the same constant; the latest (SimpleTES) supersedes the earlier ones, so the event is moved to it (F8). Codes are unchanged: every event is an AI-generated upper-bound construction, so status progress / generated / null holds regardless of anchor. Verification is 'checkable' in the sense of explicit step functions; only TTT-Discover's bound has a named human checker (Torlo). SimpleTES date is month-only from the arXiv id; exact ordering of TTT-Discover and TogetherAI unresolved, immaterial here. Record gives only 'Ye et al.' for SimpleTES, so credited_humans lists only Haotian Ye.

outcome_prefix: Judged: the status rests on SimpleTES (Ye et al., arXiv 2604.19341, April 2026), whose AI-generated construction gives the current record upper bound 0.380868, superseding the AlphaEvolve, TTT-Discover and TogetherAI bounds.

corrections.why: F8: the record's summary says SimpleTES's 0.380868 is 'the most recent and tightest'; under §4 step 3 a later bound on the same quantity supersedes earlier ones, so the status rests on it, not on the first AI improvement.

corrections.from: AlphaEvolve, TTT-Discover and SimpleTES people combined
